name: Matsuda Yukari
source:
Occupation: Producer
Activities: Photography
Favorite things: Cameras, idols
Hobbies: Taking pictures of idols
Special skill: Planning concerts
Problem areas: “What if someone takes pictures of me?”
Yukari became a producer alongside the protagonist, and functions as the primary planner for the rest of the idols. 
She looks up to the protagonist like a puppy waiting for orders. 
Yukari can be too naive at times, however, becoming almost a doormat for other’s desires. 
She has a near obsession with cameras, always snapping photos of the idols. However, Yukari hates when cameras are pointed in her direction.
Her measurements grow up to 128(S)-60-90
